guide.quote: For Q1, we estimate our adjusted EBITDA loss to be in the range of $160 million to $180 million.
For Q2, we estimate our adjusted EBITDA loss to be in the range of $170 million to $200 million.

source.quote: Q2 adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $177 million, which is on the lower end of our guidance range of $170 million to $200 million and only a slight increase quarter-over-quarter.

We anticipate revenue to grow in Q4 from Q3 and to be in the range of $5 million to $6 million as we pick up our pace of operations at Hawthorne and continue to deliver additional engines and batteries for Omen.

We expect an adjusted EBITDA loss in the range of $185 million to $205 million as we continue to mature our Midnight certification and flight test program, begin Midnight operations in LA, advance our Halo development program and develop and launch our AI products.
Adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $178.5 million, which is at the lower end of our guided range of $170 million to $200 million and better than consensus.
